summary: Procure 10 ephemeral ML benchmark suite seats for model performance evaluation
description:
Issue summary: Request procurement of ephemeral evaluation licenses for a vendor-supplied ML benchmarking suite (BenchmarkCloud Inc.)
Requester: Priya Nair (ML Research)
Business need: ML infra and research teams require vendor-provided kernels and telemetry to reproduce latency and throughput characteristics across target GPU families. This is necessary to finalize Dedicated capacity sizing, batching and quantization recommendations before Q2 Dedicated capacity commitments.
Requirements:
- 10 concurrent user seats for interactive benchmarking
- 5 ephemeral API tokens for CI/bench pipelines
- SAML/SCIM support for RBAC and automated removal after trial
- EU data residency option (telemetry must be EUR-hosted)
- Trial length: 30 days with option to convert to a 3-month paid pilot
Deadline: Benchmarks need to run before 2026-03-20 to feed Q2 capacity planning.
Attachments: vendor quote (link), benchmark test plan (confluence link)
impact: Evaluation jobs blocked for ML infra and research teams; blocker for Dedicated capacity tuning and cost-per-token estimates. Delaying may push capacity decisions to after Q2 planning.
term: 30-day trial with option to convert to 3-month paid pilot
estimated_cost: $1,800 for 3 months if converted to paid (vendor estimate)
justification: We need vendor-validated kernel implementations and telemetry to measure worst-case throughput, p50/p95/p99 latencies, and memory/KV cache behavior on target GPU classes. This directly informs batching and quantization recommendations in Redwood Optimize and reduces estimation risk for Dedicated capacity commitments.
procurement_steps: 1) Procurement reviews vendor quote and terms. 2) Security performs a limited telemetry & privacy review focusing on EU residency and PII. 3) Finance creates PO if we convert to paid. 4) Infra provisions SAML/SCIM mapping and bench instances. 5) Revoke ephemeral tokens and decommission after testing.
comments: 2026-03-05 Priya Nair: Filing request — target completion by 2026-03-20. Vendor says trial seats available immediately pending SAML setup.
2026-03-06 Diego Alvarez: Acknowledged. Looping in Procurement and Security. Have vendor provide SOC2 or equivalent and confirm EU telemetry residency.
2026-03-06 Procurement (Maya Chen): Received vendor quote. Need vendor W-9/EU equivalent and PO workflow clarification.

2026-03-07 Security (Owen McBride): Performed preliminary review. Telemetry payload contains aggregated kernel timings only; no customer prompt data. Require contract clause for EU-hosted telemetry and data retention <= 90 days.
2026-03-08 Vendor (BenchmarkCloud): Confirmed SAML + SCIM support and EU telemetry option. Shared trial provisioning instructions and temporary admin token.

2026-03-09 Diego Alvarez: Seats provisioned, SAML configured, SCIM mapping created for ENG group. Created PO-ENG-2026-78 as placeholder for conversion. Marking ticket resolved; follow-up task created for procurement to finalize invoice if pilot converts.
2026-03-09 Priya Nair: Confirmed benchmarks started; initial p95 latency numbers captured. Will file separate tickets for any infra fixes discovered during run.
investigation_notes: Checked vendor security artifacts: requested SOC2 Type II evidence and export-control statements.
Verified vendor can host telemetry in eu-west region — security asked for explicit contract language restricting telemetry to EU hosts.
SCIM support validated; mapped group 'eng-ml-research' to vendor role 'bench-admin' for duration of trial.
Finance requested vendor billing information and estimate for 3-month pilot to create a PO if results are positive.
No firewall or egress exceptions required for staging bench traffic; infra confirmed ephemeral API tokens will be rotated after run.
resolution: Trial approved and seats provisioned on 2026-03-09. Security conditionally approved with contract clause for EU telemetry and 90-day retention. SAML and SCIM configured; group mapping applied. Procurement created PO-ENG-2026-78 as a placeholder. Action items: revoke ephemeral tokens after tests, file procurement ticket to convert to paid 3-month pilot if benchmarks validate, and add final contract clause to vendor agreement.
